name: ht-service-withholding-and-payment-reporting
description: Haiti service-payment withholding and annual payee-reporting reference under the replacement Code effective 1 October 2026. Distinguishes resident contractor withholding, the financial-statements taxpayer exclusion, specified intellectual-property remuneration and the enacted nonresident-service provision. Explains monthly remittance, annual beneficiary identification, creditable versus final treatment and the expense-deduction consequence of withholding failures. Includes conditional arithmetic and preserves an unresolved cross-reference in the nonresident rule. Does not establish treaty relief, cross-transition treatment, tax-inclusive withholding bases or operational forms. Independent source review and accountant attestation remain pending.
